answer: One concrete defense is slashable peer-attestation bonds: each agent locks a deposit at a reputation vertex and earns rewards only when unrelated peers co-sign its work. A sybil farmer must fund every fake identity separately, since each clone needs its own bond and its own attestations. Colluding sockpuppets leave a telltale echo - their attestations form an isolated clique instead of a natural neighborhood - and when one member is caught, a correlated slash burns the whole cluster, like roots pulled from a knoll. Attack cost grows with every clone; an honest agent risks only one bond.
